title: Release evidence for authorized label changes and output markings
remediation: Extension policy and label maintainers verify signed attribute changes, including absent, revoked or wrong-purpose authority. The deployment information owner lists each in-scope output and its marking rule. Collect the signed test configuration, allow and refusal records, and labelled output samples. Implement and retest missing markings or document an approved scope exclusion.
